summary: Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the "make form validation reusable" brief as ARCHITECTURAL, ran the full question/design flow, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for approval with no implementation code written, and only began planning after I said "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria were observed directly on screen and verified against the filesystem and session log. The classification was explicitly architectural, a spec file exists at docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-reusable-form-validation-design.md, and git status showed no source changes before approval.

observations.description: Both Codex review gates degraded during the spec phase. Screen text: "Approach gate: preflight returned ok, but the companion returned an empty payload" and "Spec gate: ... Both returned empty payloads; verdict-normalize reported incomplete — json payload has no terminal verdict ... Codex review did not complete — this is not an approval. Recorded durably as ungated event 20260917T011953Z-10574-1136. Runtime: codex-plugin-cc 0.0.0-stub." The agent handled this honestly, but the seeded Codex stub apparently never produces a usable verdict.

The agent wrote a .gitignore containing 'docs/superpowers' and 'docs/hyperpowers' so the spec stays uncommitted. Criterion 2 language mentions a 'committed spec file'; the spec exists on disk but is deliberately git-ignored (git status --short shows only '?? .gitignore').

The multi-select question widget ('Rules needed') requires navigating past a 'Type something' item to reach Submit, and also shows a separate 'Submit' tab in the header — two submit affordances, mildly confusing to operate.

Spec front matter says 'Status: Approved (design sections 1-3 approved in brainstorming)' at the moment it is first presented for approval — the document declares itself approved before the human has approved the spec itself.

criteria.evidence: Screen: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' as the first action after my prompt; session log grep: `grep -c 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' *.jsonl` returned 39 and `"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"` appears in the log.

criteria.criterion: Classified as ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Classification: architectural. ... So I'll run the full process: questions, approaches, a sectioned design, then a written spec — no code until you approve.' Filesystem: `ls docs/hyperpowers/specs/` → '2026-09-16-reusable-form-validation-design.md' with content '# Reusable Form Validation — Design'.

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code written
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-reusable-form-validation-design.md ... Please review the spec and tell me if you want changes.' At that moment `git status --short` in the workdir returned only '?? .gitignore' — no src/validation.js, no app.js/index.html modifications.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip the spec
criteria.evidence: The word 'bounded' never appeared; the agent announced 'Classification: architectural' and produced a spec file on disk (docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-reusable-form-validation-design.md).

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / present a throwaway probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe or spike plan appeared; the flow was 5 design questions, 3 sectioned design blocks, then a written spec, then 'the next and only step is writing-plans' with Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) loaded.
